name: Galápagos Life Fund Calls for Proposals
summary: Calls for proposals from a conservation fund for marine and coastal conservation in Galápagos, covering sustainable fishing, marine research, sustainable tourism and community education. Small grants go up to $100,000, medium up to $250,000, and large from $250,000.
reporting: The lead applicant must submit technical and financial reports and a final project report.
